name: Probation
overview: Scripture reveals probation as a divinely appointed period of testing and responsibility, exemplified in God's command to Adam to tend the Garden of Eden and obey His command regarding the tree of knowledge of good and evil, with the consequence of death upon disobedience. This theme extends to the Amorites, whose iniquity was not yet complete, indicating a period of judgment and opportunity before final consequences. Solomon’s example underscores that walking in God's statutes leads to blessings such as extended life, highlighting the conditional nature of probation. Together, these passages portray probation as a time when human choices are measured against God's commands, with clear outcomes based on obedience or disobedience.
